picks.title: Sekondo Puts ChatGPT and Claude Inside After Effects and Premiere Pro.
picks.excerpt: Sekondo plugin connects ChatGPT and Claude desktop apps to After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and Lightroom Classic; the AI works inside the artist's own project rather than generating new clips.
picks.rationale: A new plugin lets ChatGPT and Claude work directly inside an editor's own After Effects and Premiere projects instead of generating new clips. Motion and edit artists can install it and use it right away.

picks.title: WGA East Moves to Block AI Models from Training on Members’ Work with New Software Partner Cloak: ‘Give Agency Back to Writers’
picks.excerpt: The Writers Guild of America East is partnering with Cloak, a software program that makes scripts unreadable to AI models, preventing training.
picks.rationale: A major writers' union is giving members software that makes their scripts unreadable to AI training. It is a concrete new protection that writers can use now.

picks.title: Two-Thirds of Microdramas Released in Latest Quarter Outside China Were AI Generated, Says Report
picks.excerpt: A recent Owl & Co. report on verticals viewership also found stories with synthetic actors were the highest performers in terms of minutes watched.
picks.rationale: New Owl & Co. data shows two-thirds of microdramas released outside China last quarter were AI-generated, and synthetic-actor titles led in minutes watched. It is hard evidence that AI has taken over one fast-growing format.

picks.title: AI Could ‘Absolutely’ Replace Human Actors, CEO of Generative AI Startup Runway Says at Italy’s View Conference: ‘It’s Already Happening in a Way’
picks.excerpt: AI could replace actors, Runway CEO Cristóbal Valenzuela says at a View Conference fireside chat.
picks.rationale: The CEO of Runway, one of the AI video tools filmmakers use most, said on the record that AI could 'absolutely' replace human actors and that it is already happening. It is a direct statement of where a key tool vendor is headed, which matters to anyone casting or performing.

picks.title: Japan Actors Union Develops Guidelines for Generative AI Use
picks.excerpt: Dragon Ball cast members discuss how generative AI affects them in press conference
picks.rationale: Japan's actors union has issued formal guidelines on generative AI use, presented with Dragon Ball voice cast members. It sets new consent rules for the anime and dubbing pipeline.
